name: Mirzapore Best Leaf Tea 400g
description: A popular black leaf tea blended from Bangladeshi tea estates in Sylhet and Chattogram. Produces a strong, bright and aromatic cup.

name: Frooto Mango Fruit Drink 1L
description: A refreshing mango-flavoured fruit drink, best served chilled. A familiar summer favourite across Bangladesh.

name: Chilli Powder 200g
description: Finely ground red chilli powder for curries, bhuna and marinades. Adds colour and a strong, even heat to everyday Bengali cooking.

name: Turmeric Powder 200g
description: Pure ground turmeric (holud) with a deep golden colour. An essential spice for dal, fish and vegetable dishes.

name: Chinigura Aromatic Rice 1kg
description: Small-grain aromatic rice, traditionally used for polao, biryani and khichuri. Soft, fragrant and fluffy when cooked.

name: Soyabean Oil 5L
description: Refined soyabean oil for everyday frying and cooking. Light in flavour and suitable for a wide range of dishes.

name: Chanachur 350g
description: A crunchy, spicy snack mix of fried lentils, peanuts and gram flour noodles. Often enjoyed with muri or alongside tea.

name: Energy Plus Biscuit
description: A light, crispy tea biscuit and a household name in Bangladesh. A handy snack for school, work or travel.

name: Beauty Soap
description: A mild fragrant beauty soap for daily bathing, from a long-established Bangladeshi personal care brand.

name: Coconut Hair Oil 200ml
description: A light coconut-based hair oil for daily use, a familiar product in Bangladeshi households. Use as directed on the label.

name: Coconut Oil 200ml
description: Pure coconut oil commonly used for hair and skin care. Comes in a handy bottle with a flip cap.

name: Petroleum Jelly 100ml
description: A soft petroleum jelly used to moisturise dry skin and lips. Made by a well-known Bangladeshi personal care brand.

name: Baby Lotion 200ml
description: A gentle everyday lotion that keeps skin soft and moisturised. Check the label and patch-test before first use.

name: UHT Full Cream Milk 1L
description: Long-life full cream milk from Aarong Dairy, packed in a 1 litre carton. Keeps without refrigeration until opened.

name: Butter 200g
description: Creamy table butter from Aarong Dairy. Good for spreading, cooking and baking.

name: Sweet Yogurt 500g
description: Traditional sweet yogurt (mishti doi) set in a cup, with a smooth texture and caramelised sweetness.

name: Pasteurised Liquid Milk 1L
description: Fresh pasteurised milk from the Milk Vita cooperative, one of the best-known dairy brands in Bangladesh. Keep refrigerated.

name: Butter 200g
description: Salted table butter from Milk Vita. A familiar choice for toast, paratha and cooking.

name: Ghee 500g
description: Clarified butter (ghee) with a rich aroma, used in polao, khichuri and sweets.

name: Doi (Yogurt) 500g
description: Plain set yogurt (doi) made from fresh milk. Enjoyed on its own or with rice and in drinks like borhani.
